scope: Project-authored exact finite laws/matrix arithmetic; no upstream engine or model execution

common_calendar.law: Independent fair daily U; source S=U xor Bernoulli(1/4); next outcome T=U xor independent Bernoulli(1/4). Earlier T independent of current U.
common_calendar.units: daily calendar shock shared across accounts; account copies do not create new shock units

structural_lags.clock: One model step is one day; two-step observations span two days. A structural innovation impulse is distinct from setting a state coordinate.

unit_threshold.meaning: Same monetary response, different coefficient magnitude; threshold flag supplies no p-value.

surrogate_rank.assumption: Observed statistic and19 null replicates are continuous and exchangeable;20 equally likely ranks.
surrogate_rank.limit: Plus-one correction does not create exchangeability for an invalid temporal/conditional surrogate.

supplied_model_intervention.law: Fair latent U, A=U xor independent Bernoulli(1/4), next-period Y=U.
supplied_model_intervention.meaning: The observed two-variable law also fits an A-to-Y model; choosing supplied graph changes the intervention query.

regime_pooling.law: Two equally weighted calendar eras; independent centered source with unit variance in each; slopes+1 and-1; mean-zero noise independent of source.
regime_pooling.meaning: Pooled zero linear prediction coefficient hides opposing era-specific effects; mechanism invariance needs its own assessment.
